ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of low-intensity (dark charcoal) to high-intensity (off-white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A large contiguous low-intensity dark region covers the central 80% of the visible fluke. High-intensity light-colored pigment is localized to the distal margins of both lobes, with the right lobe displaying more distinct fragmentation by vertical low-intensity streaks.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression at the central lobe junction; estimated pixel depth is approximately 12% of the total vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular, high-frequency serrated boundary characterized by frequent peaks and valleys of varying amplitude (2-8 pixels) along the entire trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex-upward curvature originating from the median notch and extending to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially dense clusters of elevated, roughly circular, high-intensity light pixel groups (consistent with barnacle colonization) located at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple parallel, high-contrast dark linear pixel streaks (rake marks) oriented vertically on the high-intensity light patch of the right lobe's distal region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized clusters of surface anomalies at both fluke tips; distinct parallel linear vertical markings on the right lobe distal region.
